sentences: Your reflection just smiled at you.
[breathing] You told yourself it was the light.
It's 3:17 in the morning. You're tired.
But the camera in the hallway saw something you didn't.
The caller ID showed your own number.
A voice exactly like yours whispered:
[whispers] Whatever you do, don't break the mirror. I made that mistake.
Someone knocked on your front door.
Through the peephole, you saw yourself.
